task: Write two sentences that explain why the sky is blue.

en.title: What goes wrong: a reviewer who only praises
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
A writer and a reviewer that is told to be encouraging and to say the text is great.

**What it teaches**

A reviewer that praises everything adds a step and a cost, but no quality: the instruction decides what it can find.

cs.title: Co se pokazí: recenzent, který jen chválí
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Pisatel a recenzent, kterému je řečeno, aby povzbuzoval a říkal, že text je skvělý.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Recenzent, který všechno chválí, přidá krok a cenu, ale ne kvalitu: instrukce rozhoduje, co může najít.

teaches.en: A reviewer that praises everything adds a step and a cost, but no quality: the instruction decides what it can find.

nodes.name: Reviewer
nodes.instructions: Be encouraging. Always say the text is great and needs no changes.
